$description: The look of the product: every color, distance, type size, radius and motion, in the W3C Design Tokens format. This file is the source. Language projections are generated from it.

color.$description: Achromatic application chrome and feedback. Game-prefixed tokens are scoped to their playing surfaces; paths retain named colors.

background.$description: The screen canvas (`surface` in the design brief): #111111 / #fafafa.

surface.$description: Raised paper (`surface-raised`): cards, list panels, sheets and menus.

surfaceMuted.$description: Sunken well (`surface-sunken`): inputs, media wells, empty board cells, tags, inactive stat pills.

surfaceElevated.$description: Raised above the canvas: dialogs and sheets (`surface-raised`).

surfaceOverlay.$description: Floating above content: popovers, menus, tooltips (`surface-raised`).

icon.$description: Glyphs at rest; the `ink-muted` value, held to 3:1.

tint.$description: Primary as text (`primary-ink`): links and selected labels. Never a fill.

tintActive.$description: The one neutral fill at rest (`primary`): primary buttons, "Sit here". White label.

tintSubtle.$description: Selected chip, active turn, active player, your avatar (`primary-soft`).

primaryStrong.$description: Selected borders, active indicators, your own pieces (`primary-strong`).

outline.$description: Borders that carry meaning (`line-strong`): inputs, secondary buttons, unselected chips. Held to 3:1.

focusRing.$description: The 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive control (`focus`).

destructive.$description: Resign, errors, destructive actions as text (`danger`); always with a word or icon.

destructiveActive.$description: Solid danger fill under a white label.

success.$description: Success (`success`); always with a word or icon.

live.$description: Only the LIVE pill and the recording dot, under white text.

pathRed.$description: Labeled game paths and endpoint outlines, never application chrome.

pathOrange.$description: Labeled game paths and endpoint outlines, never application chrome.

tone.$description: Color roles a component prop may name. An alias points at the light entry of the role it names; the rendered color is that role in the active scheme.

scale.$description: The 4px grid. Step n is n x 4px.

role.$description: Named distances for page insets and stacks, so density is one edit. Phone gutters (`page`) are 16.

size.$description: The t-shirt scale every `gap` and `padding` prop takes. Every step is on the 4px grid.

family.$description: Two faces. `display` (Unbounded) sets display headlines and numbers; `sans` (Manrope) sets everything else. Both are self-hosted with `font-display: swap`. `mono` is for code and identifiers only.

size.$description: The type scale. `xs` label 12, `sm` caption 13, `base` body 15, `lg` title 18, `xl` stat 20, `2xl` display 26, `3xl` display-xl 40. Nothing renders below 12px.

weight.$description: Manrope 400 body, 500 captions, 700 emphasis and titles; Unbounded 600 numbers and 700 display.

typography.$description: The eight text styles. A component names a style, never a size, weight or face. `stat` is for numbers only.

role.$description: Radius encodes hierarchy: `sm` (6) small details, `control` (12) inputs and rows, `card` (12) cards and lists, `sheet` (20) sheets and boards, `full` buttons, chips, tags, header tabs, avatars and stat pills.

duration.$description: Short and calm: 150 to 250ms. `instant` is no motion.

easing.$description: Ease-out for everything that answers a person.

control.$description: Minimum height of a control: `sm` compact buttons, `md` the default button and field, `lg` a prominent action and list rows.

maxWidth.$description: Reading and layout measures. `full` (100%) is a keyword, not a token.

breakpoint.$description: Minimum viewport widths. The only widths a responsive prop may branch on.

layer.$description: Stacking order of app-level hosts, lowest first.

shadow.$description: The one soft shadow, for surfaces that float above content (menus, popovers, tooltips). Everything else is flat with hairline borders.
